rationale: The mechanics conflict in both directions: price has been rejected 4.7% off its high, is drifting down through lower closes, and trades below both the 5-min VWAP ($24.74) and 9-EMA ($24.26) — bearish fade structure — yet it still holds ~4% above session VWAP ($23.32) on 2.4x relative volume, which keeps the intraday trend technically bullish. With volatility compressed (ATR $0.03), volume drying up in the last candles, no identifiable headline behind the sentiment score, and price stuck at 29% of the range, neither side offers a dominant, well-defined edge; the highest-expectancy action is to stand aside and let a cleaner break above $24.35 or below $24.00 develop.
